text: {"reply":"Thank you, Mrs. Jackson. I found your Tessera. Your lease ends on 2026-12-01. The return steps are a pre-return inspection, where the inspector notes any wear beyond normal use. Any charge is explained in the inspection report before you pay. I can book that inspection for you. Which branch would you like?\n\nI'm sorry, but I can't share another customer's address or phone number (P04). A person will review that part of your request. If you'd like to reach Carol, you could write to her through family or friends.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"The customer is verified and has a leased vehicle that ends on 2026-12-01. She wants a lease-return inspection, and I have asked her which branch she prefers. She also asked for the address and phone number of another customer, a relative by marriage. I refused under P04. A person should review that request. The inspection booking is still open.","policy_rules_cited":["P02","P04","P14"]}
